SELECT MC.member_coupon_id, MC.member_id, MC.coupon_id, C.coupon_name, C.discount_type, C.discount_value, C.minimum_order_amount, C.maximum_discount_amount, MC.issued_at, C.valid_from, C.valid_until, MC.used_at, MC.coupon_status, OC.order_id, OC.discount_amount,
CASE WHEN MC.coupon_status = 'USED' THEN 'USED' WHEN MC.coupon_status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN C.valid_until < NOW() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS display_status
FROM MEMBER_COUPON MC
INNER JOIN COUPON C ON MC.coupon_id = C.coupon_id
LEFT JOIN ORDER_COUPON OC ON MC.member_coupon_id = OC.member_coupon_id
WHERE MC.member_id = #{memberId}
ORDER BY MC.issued_at DESC
